lines.text: David proposes to the assembly of Israel that they bring back the ark, and the whole assembly agrees.
David gathers all Israel and goes up to Baalah of Judah to bring up the ark of God.
They carry the ark from the house of Abinadab on a camel's back, celebrating with songs, harps, and trumpets.
At Chidon's threshing floor, Uzzah takes hold of the ark when oxen stumble, and the LORD strikes him.
David fears God and takes the ark aside to the house of Obed-edom, where it stays three years.
